title: 对话选项命名混乱
description: 对话选项命名混乱，混合了普通对话、具体行动和俚语，缺乏清晰命名。
evidence: Then the dialogue itself is a bit confusing since some of the options are general conversation and some are you saying specific things or an action like nodding plus there's stuff titled like "shoot the breeze" which means idle chatting but why not have simple naming convention for better comprehension and accessibility for players?

evidence_items.quote: Then the dialogue itself is a bit confusing since some of the options are general conversation and some are you saying specific things or an action like nodding plus there's stuff titled like "shoot the breeze" which means idle chatting but why not have simple naming convention for better comprehension and accessibility for players?
evidence_items.description: 对话选项命名混乱，混合了普通对话、具体行动和俚语，缺乏清晰命名
evidence_items.quote_zh: 然后对话本身也有点令人困惑，因为有些选项是普通闲聊，有些则是你说具体的话或做一个动作，比如点头，另外还有些标题像“闲聊”这样的东西，意思就是闲谈，但为什么不用简单的命名规则来让玩家更好理解和上手呢？
